title: Use only registered pesticides
what: Use a pesticide only if it is registered, unless a permit authorises its use.

sources.title: Pesticides Act 1999 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not use an unregistered pesticide unless the person— (a) is authorised to do so by a permit, and (b) complies with the permit
